carpet.rule.bigEnderChest.name: Big Ender Chest
carpet.rule.bigEnderChest.desc: Enables the server-side big ender chest. Vanilla clients get a 6x9 aggregate view while extra items remain in standard fake-player ender chest pages.
carpet.rule.bigEnderChestPageLimit.name: Big Ender Chest Page Limit
carpet.rule.bigEnderChestPageLimit.desc: Maximum extra fake-player storage pages, excluding vanilla page 0. Use 1..1024, or -1 for unlimited-until-resource-limit. Lowering this never deletes existing pages.
carpet.rule.bigEnderChestLiveFakePlayers: Big Ender Chest Live Fake Players
When enabled, only pages used by real storage transfers are brought online as fake players. Index scans and view-only access stay on the offline playerdata path.
big_ender_chest.menu.title: Big Ender Chest
big_ender_chest.sort.name: Item registry name
carpet.rule.easyPlaceProtocolExtra.name: Easy Place Protocol V2-Extra
carpet.rule.easyPlaceProtocolExtra.desc: Enables the server-side V2-Extra easy-place handshake and block-state synchronization. Client functionality is not included.
carpet.rule.onlineProfileFallback.name: Online Profile Fallback
carpet.rule.onlineProfileFallback.desc: In online mode, resolves the requested username and signed skin/cape textures, but only skips Mojang session authentication when the resolved UUID already has player data on this server. This does not verify account ownership and is intended only for private servers.
carpet.rule.playerLadder.name: Player Ladder
carpet.rule.playerLadder.desc: Master switch for the Player Ladder feature. When off, right-clicking an entity does nothing.
playerladder.rule.interactionMode.name: Interaction Path
playerladder.rule.interactionMode.desc: Selects the entity right-click path used by Player Ladder. Values: player_ladder, carry_on.
playerladder.rule.clickMode.name: Click Mode
playerladder.rule.clickMode.desc: Selects whether a right click rides the target, picks it up, or does nothing. Values: ride, pick_up, none.
playerladder.rule.pickupDepthLimit.name: Pickup Depth Limit
playerladder.rule.pickupDepthLimit.desc: Maximum passenger depth searched when picking up an entity.
playerladder.rule.rideDepthLimit.name: Ride Depth Limit
playerladder.rule.rideDepthLimit.desc: Maximum passenger depth searched when riding an entity.
playerladder.rule.allowNonPlayers.name: Allow Non-Players
playerladder.rule.allowNonPlayers.desc: Whether entities other than players can be ridden or picked up.
playerladder.rule.ignoredEntities.name: Ignored Entities
playerladder.rule.ignoredEntities.desc: Comma-separated entity ids or # tags that Player Ladder never targets.
playerladder.rule.dismountOnGameModeChan: Whether passengers dismount when the carrier changes game mode.
playerladder.rule.allowRiderStacking.des: Whether stacks of three or more players are allowed.
playerladder.rule.allowFakePlayers.name: Allow Fake Players
playerladder.rule.allowFakePlayers.desc: Whether Carpet fake players can be ridden or picked up.
